correctness.rationale: Free drift diffusion Green kernel is explicitly normalized to q=sqrt(mu^2+4Dr); the 2x2 sink resolvent gives B and T=(1-B)/(rB). Local-time Laplace functional yields B double-prime strictly negative because trajectories visit one point but not the other with positive probability. The exact endpoint derivative is a downward quadratic with positive constant and strictly negative linear/quadratic terms, proving a unique critical K and unique optimal allocation. Independent finite-matrix and lattice calculations passed 4760 checks; finite tests do not prove the theorem.

originality.rationale: The checked one-delta-trap 2026 motivating source and earlier 2013 treatment do not include simultaneous two-target resource allocation. Higher-dimensional narrow-capture multi-target theory calculates flux and varies reset rate, not the fixed-total-strength two-delta drift threshold. Optimal-resetting-distribution theory considers uncertainty in target location rather than allocating strengths between simultaneously present traps. Targeted searches did not identify a statement that entails the full unique global allocation phase transition; general resolvent/concavity methods pre-exist and priority risk remains.
residual_risks: General rank-two resolvent optimal-allocation theorems could subsume this special case without matching terms.
The literature coverage is bounded; unavailable or unindexed papers may contain a stronger equivalent allocation result.
Any extension to three or more sinks, imperfect resetting, non-exponential local reaction, or varying reset rate is unproved.

value.rationale: Fixed total reactivity is a natural constraint in target chemistry, detection and reactive surface design. The theorem gives the exact nontrivial budget at which an optimal physical design changes from a single downstream trap to genuine two-site coverage; strictly global concavity excludes hidden competing optima. It quantifies when upstream investment becomes useful despite positive drift, and the root formula is directly computable from physical D, mu, a, r. This is more than a textbook change of variables or numerical table.
